SELECT FILE_NAME,RCRE_TIME FROM D360.STG_EDS_DEP_FCFTT

UPDATE D360.STG_EDS_DEP_FCFTT SET RCRE_TIME=REPLACE(RCRE_TIME,'2024-03-25','2023-09-01')
SELECT 
SCD_START_DATE,
COUNT(*)
FROM EDS.DEP_FCFTT
GROUP BY
SCD_START_DATE
ORDER BY
SCD_START_DATE

TRUNCATE TABLE EDS.DEP_FCFTT

SELECT 
SUM(CASE WHEN SCD_START_DATE >= CAST(RCRE_TIME AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) VALID,
SUM(CASE WHEN SCD_START_DATE < CAST(RCRE_TIME AS DATE)THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) INVALID 
FROM EDS.DEP_FCFTT


where as_of_Date='2023-09-01'


SELECT * FROM EDS.DEP_CPYBPDET
TRUNCATE TABLE EDS.DEP_CUSTOMCHANNELTRANSTABLE
DELETE FROM FROM OM.OM_TASK_RUN WHERE TASK_NAME LIKE '%DEP_CPYBPDET%'
